name: TXXX
source:
You're running out of time.
It was just a stop on your way, why'd you have to complicate things?
You shouldn't have stayed in the first place…

A bittersweet one-shot set in the world of Quaint.

[From [url=https://takanohiro.itch.io/txxx]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的时间不多了。
这只是你途中的一站，为什么要让事情变得复杂呢？
你一开始就不应该留下来……

这是一部以古雅世界为背景的苦乐参半的单一镜头。

[来自[url=https://takanohiro.itch.io/txxx]Itch.io[/url]]
